description: Business logic correctness, security hardening, and code quality improvements across coordinator, backtest, report, and API layers
steps: In src/augur/registry.py (DecisionCoordinator.get_consensus): Verify the consensus algorithm has no division-by-zero risk - currently total_weight could be 0 if all agents return ERROR signal. Add guard.
In src/augur/registry.py (DecisionCoordinator.get_consensus): Ensure all agent scores are clamped to 0-10 before aggregation (some edge cases could produce out-of-range values)
In src/augur/backtest.py: Review date boundary handling - ensure generate_sample_data handles the case where days=5 (minimum) properly without index errors
In src/augur/report.py: Fix the pipe character '|' escaping issue - if any agent reasoning contains '|', it will break the markdown table. Escape '|' as '\|' in table cells.
In dashboard/app.py - /api/custom-persona POST: Add path traversal protection - ensure agent_id cannot contain '..' or '/' even though regex already validates, add explicit check
In dashboard/app.py - /api/persona/{agent_id}/opinion: Already validates persona exists (returns 404). Verify ticker validation is present (it is). Good.

In dashboard/app.py: Fix the global _ip_rate_limits dict - it can grow unbounded if many unique IPs hit the server. Add periodic cleanup (already partially done for ticker rate limits, replicate for IP limits).

In src/augur/data.py: Add input sanitization comment and ensure _normalize_ticker catches path traversal attempts like '../etc/passwd' (the regex already blocks '/' and '..' patterns due to [A-Z0-9.\-] but verify single dots in tickers like '0700.HK' are allowed while '..' is not)
In src/augur/cron.py: Verify watchlist YAML loading uses safe_load (not unsafe load) - check for yaml.load without Loader parameter
Remove any unused imports across key files (data.py, registry.py, dashboard/app.py) using a quick grep for common unused patterns
In src/augur/report.py generate_report: The function starts with 'section' (partial read showed incomplete) - ensure 'sections = []' initialization is correct
In dashboard/app.py: Ensure version string '7.8.0' is updated to '7.8.1' in the FastAPI app and health endpoint
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m pytest tests/ passes all existing tests
No division by zero possible in consensus calculation when all agents error
Pipe characters in reasoning do not break markdown table output
verification: python3 -c "from augur.report import generate_report; print('report imports OK')"
python3 -c "from augur.registry import DecisionCoordinator; print('coordinator imports OK')"
